enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Remains still. Turns over. Pulls blanket. Continues sleeping. Adjusts pillow. Shifts position. Remains asleep.

Wakes up. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Sits at table. Picks up spoon. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Places spoon on table. Wipes mouth with napkin. Stands up. Carries bowl to sink. Places bowl in sink. Returns to table. Picks up glass. Drinks water. Places glass in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects clothes. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Looks in mirror. Brushes hair. Picks up bag. Checks phone. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Puts on headphones. Listens to music. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enters clinic. Puts on lab coat. Washes hands. Greets patients. Checks patient charts. Takes vital signs. Administers medication. Consults with doctors. Writes notes. Uses computer. Answers phone. Attends meeting. Takes break. Continues working.

Walks to cafeteria. Stands in line. Selects food. Pays for food. Carries tray to table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Talks with colleague. Clears tray. Throws away trash. Walks back to work area.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Puts on headphones. Listens to music. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Places on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Fills pot with water. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Chops vegetables. Adds ingredients to pot. Stirs. Turns off stove. Serves food onto plate. Carries plate to table. Sits down. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table. Washes hands.

Walks to living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on couch. Changes channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Returns with snack. Sits down. Eats snack. Watches TV. Turns off TV.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies dish soap. Picks up plate. Scrubs plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in drying rack. Picks up glass. Scrubs glass. Rinses glass. Places glass in drying rack. Picks up fork. Scrubs fork. Rinses fork. Places fork in drying rack. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel.

Walks to living room. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Waits for boot. Opens browser. Navigates to website. Watches video. Types message. Checks email. Plays game. Uses mouse. Adjusts chair. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Returns with drink. Sits down. Continues using computer. Turns off computer.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Applies shampoo. Scrubs hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around hair. Turns off light. Walks out.
Walks to bedroom. Turns on lamp. Picks up book. Sits on bed. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.
